data.response:
I’d pick **Rossi Idraulica**, subject to confirming the warranty in writing.

1. **Rossi: €3,950 including VAT.** Installation and old boiler removal included. Ten year warranty with annual servicing. Quoted availability: two weeks.
2. **TermoCasa: €4,148 including VAT** (€3,400 + 22%). Five year warranty. Quoted availability: next week. Removal unspecified.

Rossi saves **€198** and offers longer quoted cover. The quotes are undated, so availability needs reconfirming. Vaillant’s published [seven year warranty programme](https://www.vaillant.it/servizi/garanzia/estensione-garanzia-7-caldaie/) doesn’t verify Rossi’s ten year offer.
